R0258.title: Fake Route Billing Fraud
R0258.definition: Forging or tampering with logistics route nodes to fraudulently claim billing, settlement, and freight subsidies.
R0258.description:
Fake route billing fraud fabricates, tampers with, or duplicate-enters logistics route nodes (pickup, transit, delivery, sign-off) to inflate billed mileage, node counts, or timeliness bonuses, fraudulently claiming settlement and subsidies.

The risk often involves insider or partner-site collusion, causing inflated freight and subsidy losses and distorting timeliness and route data. Detection must combine route tamper-proofing, node-trajectory comparison, and abnormal billing monitoring.
R0258.influence: Fake route billing fraud causes inflated freight and subsidy expenditure, distorts route and timeliness data, and may mask goods and fulfillment violations.

observables: Logistics routing nodes are forged or duplicated to inflate metered mileage
Pickup, transit, delivery, and sign-off node trajectories mismatch reality
Anomalous metering concentrates on specific stations or partners
Route-data tamper-proofing is missing or bypassed
Node fabrication accompanies inflated shipping and subsidy payouts
